cards.name: Yet Another Aether Vortex
cards.oracleText:
All creatures have haste.
Players play with the top card of their libraries revealed.
Noninstant, nonsorcery cards on top of a library are on the battlefield under their owner's control in addition to being in that library.

cards.name: Yet Another Night in Vegas
cards.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, choose one that hasn't been chosen—
• See the sights — Surveil 3.
• Cause trouble — Target creature gets +1/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
• Get lost — Each player exiles a creature they control until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
• I'm fine! Let's go again! — All modes reset and can be chosen again. You lose 5 life.
• Go to bed — Sacrifice this enchantment.
